evidence:
The tools used in the appendix (lem:minor, lem:hadamard, lem:bernstein and the remark near line 107) are all standard, so textbook citations are enough.

- **Horn & Johnson, Matrix Analysis, 2nd ed.** (CUP, print 2012-10-22, DOI 10.1017/CBO9781139020411): confirmed through Crossref metadata. The 1985 edition's CUP page (10.1017/CBO9780511810817) also loaded. It covers det(I+AB)=det(I+BA), the principal-minor expansion of det(I+tX), and Hadamard's inequality with its equality case. I could not verify section or theorem numbers online. From memory, Hadamard's inequality is Thm 7.8.1.
- **DLMF Sec. 5.12** (fetched): Eq. 5.12.3 is int_0^inf t^{a-1}(1+t)^{-(a+b)} dt = B(a,b), and Eq. 5.12.1 is B(a,b)=Gamma(a)Gamma(b)/Gamma(a+b). The pi/sin(pi a) form needs b=1-a together with **DLMF 5.5.3** (fetched): Gamma(z)Gamma(1-z)=pi/sin(pi z). Section 5.12 alone does not state pi/sin.
- **Schilling, Song & Vondracek, Bernstein Functions** (De Gruyter 2012, DOI 10.1515/9783110269338): authors, title, publisher and date confirmed through Crossref. It supports the remark that cx + int log(1+xt) mu(dt) is a Bernstein (Thorin-type) function, and that x^r is complete Bernstein. The edition and series (2nd ed., Studies in Math 37) and the chapter number are from memory.

Notes are in /Users/ruhaanrajadhyaksha/projects/grok/heracles/paper/litcheck/items/u4-matrix-tools/CHECK.md.

recommended_citations.why: Sylvester identity det(I+UDU*)=det(I+DU*U) and principal-minor expansion in lem:minor; Hadamard's inequality (PSD det <= product of diagonal, equality iff diagonal) in lem:hadamard. Check theorem numbers (Hadamard ~Thm 7.8.1) before quoting them.
lem:bernstein: int_0^inf u^{a-1}/(1+u) du = B(a,1-a) (Eq. 5.12.3) = Gamma(a)Gamma(1-a) (5.12.1) = pi/sin(pi a) (reflection formula 5.5.3, https://dlmf.nist.gov/5.5).

Optional, for lem:bernstein and the remark near line 107: x^r (0<r<1) is a (complete) Bernstein function and cx+int log(1+xt)mu(dt) is a Thorin-Bernstein function, so the cost lemma extends beyond power penalties. Authors, title, publisher and year are confirmed via Crossref; edition, series and volume are from memory.
